meta_description: NT Electric-Plumbing-Handyman offers trusted electrical, plumbing, and handyman services across Leicester. Local, reliable, and competitively priced. Call today.
hero_subhead: Electrical faults, plumbing problems, or odd jobs piling up? NT Electric gets it sorted fast, properly, and at a fair price.
services_heading: Electrical, Plumbing & Handyman Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: From full rewires and fault finding to boiler checks and general repairs, we handle the jobs that keep your home running safely.

services.title: Electrical Installations
services.desc: From new socket and lighting installations to full consumer unit upgrades, all work is carried out to current BS 7671 wiring regulations. You'll receive an Electrical Installation Certificate on completion for complete peace of mind.

services.title: Fault Finding & Repairs
services.desc: Tripping circuits, flickering lights, or dead sockets can signal a serious underlying issue. We diagnose and resolve electrical faults quickly, minimising disruption to your home or business.

services.title: Electrical Safety Inspections (EICR)
services.desc: Whether you're a landlord meeting legal obligations or a homeowner buying a new property, our Electrical Installation Condition Reports give you a clear picture of your installation's safety.

services.title: Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Leaking pipes, dripping taps, and blocked drains handled promptly and professionally. We fix the problem at its source rather than applying a temporary patch.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Fitting
services.desc: From fitting a new bathroom suite to replacing kitchen appliances and tiling, we manage the full job so you don't need to co-ordinate multiple tradespeople.

services.title: General Handyman Services
services.desc: Flat-pack assembly, door and lock repairs, plastering, painting, shelving, and more — if it needs doing around the house, NT Electric can take care of it.

about_pullquote: Every job gets the same attention, whether it's a new socket or a full rewire.
about_para_1: NT Electric-Plumbing-Handyman was established in Leicester by Norman, a qualified electrician with over a decade of hands-on experience across residential and light commercial properties. Based in Braunstone Town, we've built a reputation throughout Leicester for honest advice, tidy workmanship, and getting the job done right first time.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is the breadth of what we offer under one name — electrical, plumbing, and handyman skills mean fewer call-outs for you and a single point of contact for everything. Our customers come back because they know they'll get a straight quote, no hidden extras, and a tradesperson who respects their home.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About NT Electric

reviews.text: Norman came out the same day to sort a tripping circuit that two other electricians had failed to fix properly. Found the fault within half an hour, explained everything clearly, and the price was very reasonable. Will definitely be using him again.
reviews.author: Karen B.

reviews.text: Used NT Electric for a full consumer unit replacement and a couple of new sockets in the kitchen. Turned up on time, left the place spotless, and the certificate was with me by the end of the day. Straightforward and professional throughout.
reviews.author: Raj P.

reviews.text: Really glad I found Norman. He sorted a leaking pipe under the sink, fixed a broken door lock, and hung some shelving all in one visit. Having one reliable tradesman who can turn his hand to most things is brilliant. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Michelle T.
